description: This file contains implementation of functions and classes for converting in-place tensor operations to out-of-place operations within the PyTorch JIT compiler, specifically for ONNX export. It includes mechanisms for tracking aliasing, replacing get/set attribute nodes, and handling mutation removal.

classes.name: InplaceConverter
classes.description: Handles conversion of in-place tensor operations to out-of-place for ONNX, including alias tracking and attribute node replacement.

classes.name: InplaceConverter::ValueTracker
classes.description: Tracks aliases of values affected by in-place operations to ensure correct reference updates.

methods.name: RemoveInplaceOpsForONNX
methods.description: Main entry point to convert in-place tensor operations to out-of-place for ONNX export, applying mutation removal and alias tracking.
